definitions.explanation: A dish made by simmering ingredients over low heat for an extended time, allowing flavors to meld. Used both as a standalone noun for the dish itself and as a modifier describing the cooking method.

examples.japanese: {牛|ぎゅう}すじ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煮込|にこ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{煮込|にこ}み⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}ろう→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。

⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煮込|にこ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{温|あたた}めて→温める：02096_atatameru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: On cold days, a stew full of vegetables warms you up.

notes:
The noun form of ⟦{煮込|にこ}む→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧ (to simmer, to stew). Refers to any dish where ingredients are cooked slowly in liquid until tender and flavorful. A hearty comfort food category in Japanese cuisine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {煮込|にこ}み⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ — stewed dish, slow-cooked cuisine
- {煮込|にこ}み⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧ — udon noodles simmered in broth
- {煮込|にこ}み⟦ハンバーグ→ハンバーグ：01785_hanbaagu⟧ — hamburger steak simmered in sauce
- もつ{煮込|にこ}み — simmered offal (a popular izakaya dish)

CULTURAL NOTE:
もつ{煮込|にこ}み (offal stew) is a classic working-class dish often found at izakaya and street stalls. {煮込|にこ}み⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧ is a winter favorite, especially in the Nagoya region where it is called {味噌|みそ}{煮込|にこ}みうどん.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{煮込|にこ}む→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧ — to simmer, to stew (the verb form)
- ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧ — simmered dishes in general; a broader category in Japanese home cooking
